- **Experiment repository**: `/Users/richardtang/proofpress-dev/experiments/provenance_handoff`
- **Experiment runtime**: Python project managed with `uv`; current lightweight modules are `pp_eval/`.
- **Active upstream target**: STALE benchmark data plus the pinned CUPMem implementation revision recorded in the Phase 1 pilot report. Harvey LAB v1.0 remains an archived prototype target.
- **ARA upstream**: `https://github.com/ARA-Labs/Agent-Native-Research-Artifact`, local source commit `35981edc35c51413d291ab8e504ea7c907fd67e7`.
- **External data home**: `PROOFPRESS_EVAL_HOME`; raw data/traces/results stay there.
- **Planned model transport**: selected only at the STALE freeze gate, with exact requested/resolved model, provider, cost, retries, and fallback state recorded per call. Vercel/Gateway, OpenRouter/Novita, and unversioned-Flash records are archived transport history, not active routing requirements. Credentials remain outside Git.
- **Core model policy**: one homogeneous model team with `high` effort per workflow attempt; Proofpress itself never makes a model call.
- **Gateway evidence rule**: every model call must record requested/resolved model, actual provider, Gateway `usage.cost`, fallback status/metadata, token values, and latency. A record lacking any required telemetry remains audit-visible but is not qualified for a formal result; a wrapper-local `$0` is never substituted.
- **Execution state**: historical Harvey/Gateway qualification is stopped and unqualified. Its event logs and aborted manifest remain failed transport evidence, never treatment evidence. The original STALE prompt-policy pilot is superseded for causal interpretation; the production-style Proofpress carrier implementation is now the active Phase 1 work, and no held-out confirmatory efficacy run is claimed.
